description: Test suite for Kubernetes ServiceAccount admission plugin, testing behavior of service account handling, secret references, and token mounting in admission control.

methods.name: TestIgnoresNonCreate
methods.description: Tests that the admission handler does not handle delete or connect operations.

methods.name: TestIgnoresNonPodResource
methods.description: Tests that non-pod resources are allowed.

methods.name: TestIgnoresNilObject
methods.description: Tests that nil objects are allowed.

methods.name: TestIgnoresNonPodObject
methods.description: Tests that non-pod objects are allowed.

methods.name: TestIgnoresMirrorPod
methods.description: Tests that mirror pods without service account or secrets are allowed.

methods.name: TestRejectsMirrorPodWithServiceAccount
methods.description: Tests that mirror pods referencing a service account are rejected.

methods.name: TestRejectsMirrorPodWithSecretVolumes
methods.description: Tests that mirror pods referencing secret volumes are rejected.

methods.name: TestRejectsMirrorPodWithServiceAccountTokenVolumeProjections
methods.description: Tests that mirror pods referencing ServiceAccountToken volume projections are rejected.

methods.name: TestAssignsDefaultServiceAccountAndBoundTokenWithNoSecretTokens
methods.description: Tests default service account assignment and token mounting when no secret tokens are present.

methods.name: TestFetchesUncachedServiceAccount
methods.description: Tests fetching a service account not present in cache.

methods.name: TestDeniesInvalidServiceAccount
methods.description: Tests rejection when service account is invalid or missing.

methods.name: TestAutomountsAPIToken
methods.description: Tests automatic mounting of API token when enabled.

methods.name: TestRespectsExistingMount
methods.description: Tests that existing volume mounts are respected and no duplicate volumes are created.

methods.name: TestAllowsReferencedSecret
methods.description: Tests that referencing a secret that the service account references is allowed.

methods.name: TestRejectsUnreferencedSecretVolumes
methods.description: Tests rejection of secret volumes not referenced by the service account.

methods.name: TestAllowUnreferencedSecretVolumesForPermissiveSAs
methods.description: Tests that secret volumes are allowed if the service account is permissive.

methods.name: TestAllowsReferencedImagePullSecrets
methods.description: Tests that image pull secrets referenced by the service account are allowed.

methods.name: TestRejectsUnreferencedImagePullSecrets
methods.description: Tests rejection of image pull secrets not referenced by the service account.

methods.name: TestDoNotAddImagePullSecrets
methods.description: Tests that image pull secrets are not added if already present.

methods.name: TestAddImagePullSecrets
methods.description: Tests adding image pull secrets from the service account to the pod.

methods.name: testGenerateName
methods.description: Helper function to generate a name suffix for volumes.
